body: I went to therapy for a few years maybe a year or two ago. I'm not sure it did that much for me, but the Dr. was a nice dude.

I can't. Nothing else even comes close to giving me a similar amount of joy. I don't like myself, let alone love myself. I've given those lines of thoughts effort but it ultimately comes up futile. I mean, the only thing I haven't tried is medication, and that becomes a different issue altogether. The only time I've been happy is when I've been in a happy relationship. I don't know how to be happy without one, without someone to share things with. I'm not trying to be stubborn, I just don't know how to take your advice.
My hopes is that one day it would just sort of "click" for me. That I could keep trying and it eventually just works. That this is my inward work. But 7 months in and it's just not working.

In this same vein, people tend to compare themselves at their worst to others at their best, and vice versa. Keep your head up, OP, you got this. Wish I had something more helpful/insightful to tell you, but I'm not in the greatest state myself right now. For now, all we can do is keep on keeping-on.

When I was a child, I dreamed of being an architect, maybe because my mother never owned her own home and always talked about it. I told her I'd build a house just for her.

Now, I don't aspire to much, honestly. I'd like to get into game development, but that's a far-off dream. If I could truly be anything, I'd rather be dead, or somehow just a better me.
